1, I wouldn't as it's not likely they will have another time for the appointment soon.
2, you will need the bring all original documents and anything since then, especially if you waited months for this appointment.
3, it depends on your MH.
If you're lucky they will give the invitation on the spot or a few weeks later.
In some cases they will require a simultaneous interview, you at MH and your partner at the embassy.
Good luck 🤞
